name: Dingle Peninsula
summary: The Slea Head loop packs beehive huts, black cliffs, and the open Atlantic into one slow morning's drive — all of it in Irish-speaking country, with Dingle town's pubs and chowder waiting at the end. Smaller and quieter than the Ring of Kerry, and I'd argue better.
highlights: Slea Head Drive taken clockwise, early, before the buses
Dunquin's pier zig-zagging down the cliff face
An evening of music in a Dingle pub that also sells hardware
